race.comment: BURNING AMBITION (5) is the one to beat as he shoots for the hat-trick. Has shown a good turn of foot in his wins and finds a nice race to keep progressing. BROKEN WINGS (8) is the main danger after getting gunned down on the Beaumont last time. Is 1/1 on track and gets a key booking in Gallagher from a good draw. Sure to be very competitive. MEGA PIXEL (4) hasn't been far away in stronger recent grade, beaten a length in a CL3 at Tamworth before a sound midfield finish at Dubbo. Gets weight relief and has the early speed to land handy. RITZSUN (2) returns and is proven fresh performer. Hasn't won for a long time but has run well over this trip and gets in nicely at the weights after the 3kg claim. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
